description: The FIKElectricity research team publishes aggregate and appliance electricity measurements from three Portuguese kitchens. The OSF overview describes approximately three to four weeks of monitoring per kitchen, with aggregate measurements at 1 Hz. CSV variables include electrical power quantities, voltage, current, power factor and frequency, with accompanying code and documentation folders. The project is publicly accessible and free under CC BY 4.0. The records can calibrate appliance-use and demand-disaggregation components used in electricity-demand simulations with model-pypsa. A caveat is that three kitchens over short campaigns cannot represent national household behaviour or annual seasonality. The description gives appliance sampling as 1/5 Hz, while the Wiki states 0.5 Hz; users must inspect actual timestamps before combining channels. Exact campaign endpoints were not verified from the overview. No measurement files were downloaded.
